result.question: In his letter to Felix the governor, what did the chief captain say the accusation against Paul involved?

readings.support: the accusation involved questions about their own law

assessments.reason: The passage states “the accusation involved questions about their own law,” which clearly refers to the Jews’ law; this matches “Questions about Jewish law.”

result.reason: “Their own law” in the text refers to Jewish law, matching the key’s meaning.
